source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Theorems 1--4 and Eq. (11), lines 111--165; Section 3.6, lines 188--191
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper canonicalizes the complete-predecessor, single-shared-exogenous order-only class, proves sharp LP and lifted-LP endpoints, and bounds the lifted quotient by O(product_i |V_i|).

The paper reduces counterfactual bounds on arbitrary discrete graphical SCMs with observational and experimental data to canonical-SCM polynomial programs, with approximate Monte Carlo methods for the resulting expensive optimization.
The result concerns counterfactual inference in fully specified SCMs through twin-network treewidth and causal-treewidth bounds, not partial identification over unrestricted unknown mechanisms.
SAT_counterfact^lin is FPT in combined d+n and XP in n via an LP over response-function choices; it is a satisfiability result rather than the proposed sharp-bound compiler.

source_verification_receipts.version: International Journal of Approximate Reasoning 171 (2024), article 109111
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The journal article gives exact credal-network inference only on a subclass, proves general causal inference NP-hard even on polytrees, and develops approximate EM computation.
This paper symbolically compiles fixed structural equations into arithmetic circuits to accelerate repeated EM inferences and yields inner approximations, not exact order-only sharp endpoints.
